rationale: The agent appears to have located the user and order and selected the correct replacement item (size M, blue, high ventilation) with an accurate price difference ($22.55). However, it executed the exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) and charged the card without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, which violates the stated policy requirement to confirm before any write. While authentication seems to have been attempted via name and ZIP lookup and user details retrieval, the lack of explicit pre-action confirmation is a clear policy breach. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
